before.description_tag: A coconut oil lotion with only 6 ingredients — no water, no synthetic fragrance, no parabens. Absorbs quickly, never greasy. Five scents or unscented.
before.body_html:
Six ingredients. That's the whole list for this coconut oil lotion — organic virgin coconut oil, jojoba, red palm oil, and three more. No fillers, no water padding, no synthetic fragrance.

It absorbs. Most lotions sit on the surface because they're built on water and thickeners. This one soaks in quickly, leaves no slick film, and doesn't make you wait before getting dressed.

The scent comes from the oils themselves — light, natural, fades after a few minutes. Five blends to choose from, or Pure Unscented if you prefer nothing at all.

Two things to know: shake before the first pump if the bottle has been stored somewhere cool — coconut oil firms below 76°F. And texture shifts slightly batch to batch, because real oil does.

Clean ingredients, small batches, nothing hidden in the formula.

after.description_tag: Coconut oil lotion made with 6 ingredients, led by organic coconut oil, jojoba and red palm oil. No synthetic fragrance or parabens. Four scents or unscented.
after.body_html:
Six ingredients, and here is every one: purified spring water, organic virgin coconut oil, organic jojoba, plant-based emulsifying wax, organic grapefruit seed extract and organic red palm oil. No mineral oil, no silicones, no synthetic fragrance, no parabens.

It absorbs. Many conventional lotions lean on mineral oil or silicones, which leave a film on the surface. This one is built on coconut oil and jojoba, which is close to the oil your skin makes, so it works in within a few minutes instead of sitting on top.

The scent comes from the oils themselves — light, natural, fades after a few minutes. Four scents to choose from, or Pure Unscented if you prefer nothing at all.

Two things to know: shake before the first pump if the bottle has been stored somewhere cool — coconut oil firms below 76°F. And texture shifts slightly batch to batch, because real oil does.

Clean ingredients, small batches, nothing hidden in the formula.
